name: City of Sun
description: The golden starting capital bathed in perpetual dawn. Home to new adventurers, church healing, and starter guilds.

name: Misty Plains
description: Rolling hills blanketed in ethereal mist where wild slimes and twilight direwolves roam.

name: Merchant City
description: A bustling trade hub featuring the Grand Exchange, Mercenary Guild Tavern, and Blacksmith Enchanters.

name: Runic Highlands
description: Ancient stone pillars infused with leyline mana. Guarded by Runic Stone Guardians.

name: Goddess Temple City
description: A sacred sanctuary built atop high cliffs. Gateway to endless deep dungeons and divine trials.

name: Beginner Crypt [Floors 1-30]
description: Ancient burial site featuring rare crafting cores and starter gear drops.

name: Merchant Labyrinth [Floors 31-100]
description: Subterranean vault housing ancient treasures and dangerous phantoms.

name: Endless Abyss [Floors 101-300+]
description: Bottomless dungeon where Mythical and Godly tier beasts spawn (1%-5% chance past floor 250).
